name: voidmob-mcp
description: Non-VoIP SMS verification numbers, dedicated numbers, travel eSIMs and 4G/5G mobile proxies, paid from a prepaid VoidMob balance.
long_description:
Lets Claude search, price and buy VoidMob services from your prepaid USD balance: US non-VoIP numbers for SMS verification codes (refunded automatically when no SMS arrives), long-term rentals and private dedicated numbers, eSIM data plans for travel, and shared or dedicated 4G/5G mobile proxies with HTTP and SOCKS5 access.

Every purchase needs the price Claude showed you (max_price_cents), so nothing is bought at a price you did not see. Optional safety settings: read-only mode, a per-order limit and a spending budget for each session. Turn on sandbox mode to try every flow with mock data and no key.

Create an API key at https://dashboard.voidmob.com/developers/api-keys and fund the balance with crypto in the dashboard.

tools.name: get_rental
tools.description: Check or wait for SMS verification or rental

tools.name: toggle_auto_renew
tools.description: Set rental or dedicated number auto-renew

tools.name: topup_proxy
tools.description: Add data to a shared proxy

tools.name: regenerate_proxy_password
tools.description: Reset proxy gateway or list password

api_key.title: API key
api_key.description: Your vmk_live_... key from dashboard.voidmob.com/developers/api-keys. It can spend your balance. Leave empty with sandbox mode on.

sandbox.title: Sandbox mode
sandbox.description: Use offline mock data with a $500 play balance. No key needed and nothing is charged.

read_only.title: Read-only
read_only.description: Hide every tool that spends money or changes anything. Claude can still search prices and read your orders.

max_order_cents.title: Max per order (US cents)
max_order_cents.description: Refuse any single purchase above this, in whole US cents (2500 = $25.00). Leave empty for no limit.

budget_cents.title: Session budget (US cents)
budget_cents.description: Stop buying once this much was spent since Claude started the server, in whole US cents (5000 = $50.00). Also keeps auto-renew off. A safety net, not an account limit. Leave empty for no budget.
